source.title: A neural circuit mechanism for regulating vocal variability during song learning in zebra finches

confidence_rationale: Good source quality (eLife, intracellular recordings across development plus a network model). Marked MIXED and held at 0.62 because it cuts both ways for ARC-074: it corroborates a persistent, architecturally separate variability channel, while undercutting the specific EXIT mechanism ARC-074 commits to -- a thresholded gate that ends Phase 0 and switches scoring on.
failure_signatures: Inputs from the variability-inducing pathway remained unchanged across development while the song-driving inputs were strengthened and pruned. Exploration is therefore never switched off; the circuit's SENSITIVITY to it declines as task-specific connectivity consolidates. An implementation whose Phase 0 ends at a residue_entropy_min / z_self_loss_max threshold is modelling a discrete transition that this circuit does not appear to make.

If the exit from exploration is graded and emergent from the learning itself, then ARC-074's gate-failure error path (raise a training error if criteria are unmet within epoch_steps) encodes a transition shape with no biological counterpart here.

mapping.source_claim_statement: In the songbird motor cortex analogue RA, inputs from the song-patterning pathway (HVC) are strengthened and pruned over development while inputs from the variability-inducing pathway (LMAN) remain unchanged. A network model shows that strengthening and pruning of action-specific connections reduces the circuit's sensitivity to variable input and to neural noise, coupling rising skill to falling variability.
mapping.ree_translation: Speaks to a question ARC-074 leaves underdetermined: how does Phase 0 END? ARC-074 proposes explicit gate criteria that flip E3 scoring on once thresholds are met. This result suggests biology uses no gate at all -- the exploratory drive persists undiminished, and what changes is the downstream circuit's susceptibility to it as task-specific structure consolidates. The REE analogue would be an exploration channel that is never suppressed, whose influence simply attenuates as z_world and the residue field differentiate.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The mechanism is synaptic -- strengthening and pruning of specific afferents -- and REE's residue field plus E3 scoring is not a synaptic-weight substrate, so the principle may hold while the implementation has no counterpart. There is also a real risk of over-reading a single-species developmental time course as a general law about exploration-to-exploitation transitions. Songbird transfer risk applies here as for Aronov et al.
mapping.source_context: Zebra finches across song development; in-vitro intracellular recordings from RA projection neurons characterising HVC and LMAN input strength, plus a complementary network model.

confidence_components.notes: Mapping fidelity is reduced because the entry's most useful content is a challenge to ARC-074's exit mechanism rather than a test of its central assertion, and that challenge rests on a substrate analogy (synaptic consolidation to residue-field differentiation) that is loose.
